jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer - (Level II Noncommissioned)
jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods


Schedule

Full Time position:

  • Sunday: 10p-6a
  • Monday: 10p-6a
  • Tuesday: 10p-6a
  • Wednesday: 10p-6a
  • Thursday: 10p-6a
  • Friday: OFF
  • Saturday: OFF


Part Time position:

  • Saturday 2p-10p
  • Sunday 2p-10p


Uniform & Equipment

  • FRPS Provides: Uniform shirt, hats, cold weather gear
  • Officer Provides: Duty pants, black boots


Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)
  • Shifts: 8 hours per day


Full-Time Employee Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO):
    • 1st Year: Accrue up to 7 days (56 hours)
    • 2nd Year: Accrue up to 10 days (80 hours)
    • 5th Year and beyond: Accrue up to 15 days (120 hours)
  • Health Insurance:
    • Company pays up to $300/month toward employee’s health insurance
    • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage (eligible after first month)
  • Retirement:
    • 401(k) plan with up to 4% company match

Posted By:

First Responder Protective Services
4006 Belt Line Rd, Suite 138
Addison, TX 75001
Texas Department Of Public Safety Private Security Program License # C10520601


Equal Employment Opportunity

First Responder Protective Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Armed Security Officer- 1st Shift
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.

Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!

Hours

  • 8:00 am – 4:30 pm

Compensation

At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $49,040 - $61,300. Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.

Join Our Team as a Security Officer!

S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to coordinate our security function. As a Security Officer, you’ll be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and supporting our diverse team. Officers perform duties in three main categories, including patrolling the S&C Ridge Boulevard Industrial Campus facility, working in the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and operating the security gatehouses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Utilize strong, written communication skills by creating clear and accurate incident and field activity reports in a timely manner.
  • Conduct and document events/ investigations with close attention to detail; gather and summarize statements and facts for records.
  • Perform routine and scheduled patrols of the S&C Campus to: regulate traffic and parking, ensure team member safety, respond to emergencies/incidents.
  • Act as first responders to critical and emergent situations including: medical emergencies, fires, hazardous material releases/spills, unauthorized personnel on campus, confined space rescues, severe weather, and building evacuations.
  • Certify and maintain required certification in the use of self-contained breathing apparatus and/or respirators.
  • Monitor fire, building supervisory, high-voltage supply, intrusion alarm, and closed-circuit video systems while assigned to the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC).
  • Monitor entry/exit and access to S&C Campus, with attention to detail for guiding team members, vehicles, visitors, and contractors. Maintain accurate logs and records of all commercial-related entrants.
  • Issue temporary identification badges and parking permits to authorized individuals.
  • Coordinate logistics of commercial deliveries and shipments from the GSOC.
  • Operate communication systems by serving as radio dispatchers and telephone switchboard operators during off-hours.
  • Directly identifying and addressing safety, trespassing and workplace violence concerns, which may include, but is not limited to, the detaining of threatening individuals for police resolution.
  • Safely remove unauthorized individuals from the campus using various de-escalation techniques.
  • Maintaining licensing and certifications for essential training and equipment necessary to perform job duties. (PERC, FOID, DL)
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
  • Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
  • Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
  • Drive a car or other vehicle.
  • Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • High School diploma or acceptable General Educational Development (GED), some college preferred.
  • Illinois Driver’s License and Illinois Firearms Owner’s Identification Card.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills; proficiency with personal computers.
  • State of Illinois Security Officer 40-Hour Training Program for armed security
  • A Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC) and ability to successfully obtain the Firearm Authorization Card (FAC) issued from the State of Illinois, Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.
  • 4 years of security or related background. Industrial security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong computer and technological skills
  • Conflict resolution skills
  • De-escalation and high stress management skills
  • Understanding laws and regulations pertaining to armed security work
  • Understanding signals of distress or impairment in others

Preferred

  • Associates Degree in Security, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, or related field.
  • Any advanced National Incident Management System (NIMS) training.
  • Handcuffing certification.
  • De-escalation training i.e., Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) or Crisis Intervention (CIT) Training certifications

Major Physical Demands

  • Frequently required to stand and perform tasks for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position and perform desk-based for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
  • Frequently required to walk moderate distances up to [1-2 miles on campus while patrolling] [frequency – e.g., multiple times each day]
  • Occasionally required to solo lift and/or carry items ranging in weight from 5 to 40 lb, and team lift and carry items or other team members to safety, exercising sound judgment to employ manual handling or machine lifts where required and risk assessments, if appropriate.
  • Occasionally required to position self to perform tasks involving but not limited to reaching, twisting, rotating, and pushing/pulling.
  • Occasionally required to use hand-eye coordination to control both hands and arms for a full range of motion to operate equipment/machinery/power tools/office productivity equipment.
  • Frequently ascending or descending ladders/stairs/scaffolding/ramps/poles.
  • Frequently required to observe details at close range, including depth perception, peripheral vision, and the ability to differentiate between colors.
  • Continuously required to talk and hear in person and by phone/conference calls.
  • Frequently required to travel (up to 10%) and work extended hours when necessary.

S&C Electric is committed to equal-opportunity employment. All employees and applicants will be considered without regard to age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation to complete the application, please email us at TAsupport@sandc.com .

jobs.description:
Hiring for various events and weekend work in the Chicago Suburbs. Locations vary per event and pay rate starts at $18.00/hr. Increased pay for supervisory positions. MUST HAVE VALID PERC CARD, MINIMUM 20 HOUR TRAINING AND PREVIOUS EVENT SECURITY EXPERIENCE. RELIABLE TRANSPORTATION NEEDED DUE TO LOCATIONS.
Job Summary:
Provide security detail as outlined in the post orders and establish working relationships with customers, local law enforcement and fire departments. Security personnel will always perform job duties with a constant awareness of surroundings, making note of all activity that takes place in the assigned area. Security Officers must maintain a professional image and always demonstrate excellent customer service.

Basic Functions:
  • Control of entrances and movement of pedestrian and vehicle traffic.
  • Patrol of buildings and perimeters.
  • Escort of material and personnel.
  • Inspection of security and fire exposures.
  • Special assignments.
Responsibilities:
Duties may vary depending on department size, organizational structure, geographic location and post assignments. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow for certain ADA requirements. Overall general function of officers is to provide security detail as described below (Note: duties may vary depending on post orders):
  • Be on time and report to post in full uniform.
  • Maintain professional image that includes greeting customers, visitors and employees in a polite and friendly manner.
  • Be proactive in knowing all revisions to post orders and general information distributed by the customer and AFS.
  • Patrol physical property or maintain fixed post position, being diligent to report any suspicious activity and investigate accidents and criminal acts.
  • Monitor cameras or equipment in a continuous fashion as outlined in the post orders.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all emergency policies, procedures and regulations to be able to respond to alarms, incidents and emergency situations.
  • Complete Daily Activity Reports, Log Book entries, Incident Reports and all relevant reports related to job assignment.
  • Make recommendations to management on better safety and loss prevention processes as identified during daily routine.
  • Have knowledge of any life safety systems, fire panels, CCTV system computer, and other such equipment to complete job assignments. Ensure continuous and safe operation of all elevators and access doors. Know authorized contractor personnel who are responsible for maintenance and upkeep of equipment.
  • Ensure training and compliance guidelines are met as outlined by AFS and other agencies regulating the customer / market.
  • Communicate on a daily basis with Security Supervisor any new Security Issues or changes that need to be considered or implemented.
Skills and Abilities:
  • A security officer is to be honest, alert and well-disciplined as the custodians of employee and customer property and safety.
  • Constant and dedicated vigilance.
  • Strong customer service skills, exemplifying Andy Frain Services Mission Statement.
  • Ability to be a hands-on, results oriented employee, handling multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to facilitate progressive change, work as part of a team and follow directions.
  • Work with a sense of urgency.
  • Strong oral and written communications skills.
This description portrays in general terms the type and level(s) of work performed and is not intended to be all-inclusive, nor the specific duties of any one incumbent. Andy Frain Services reserves the right to modify, supplement, delete or augment the duties and responsibilities specified in the position description, in the Company's sole and absolute discretion. jobs.title: School Safety and Security Site Lead
jobs.description:
Description: The School Safety and Security Site Lead is responsible for maintaining the overall safety, security, and physical integrity of the school campus during after-school hours, evening programs, and special events. This role is responsible for maintaining high situational awareness through active technology monitoring, physical patrols, and effective conflict de-escalation to ensure a secure environment for students, staff, and visitors. This is a part-time position (FTE 0.7).

The work calendar is attached. On student attendance days, the position works 3:00 pm - 9:00 pm. On non-student attendance days, the position works 8:00 am - 1:30 pm.

Job Summary

  • Surveillance and Patrol: Actively monitor campus security cameras, access control systems and conduct regular physical rounds of the building and grounds to ensure all areas are secure for extra-curricular activities.
  • Emergency Response and De-escalation: Lead the initiation and coordination of emergency response protocols in accordance with district crisis plans. Utilize verbal de-escalation techniques to resolve low-level conflicts or unauthorized presence on campus. This also includes responding immediately to address safety concerns and emergency situations.
  • Liaison Duties: Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison between first responders (police, fire, EMS) and school administration, particularly the School Safety and Emergency Preparedness Coordinator during after-hours incidents or emergencies.
  • Access Control and Visitor Management: Communicate safety information as needed when managing visitors. Verify authorized access for after-school facility rentals and community groups.
  • Safety Promotion: Promote a safe and professional school environment by observing and reporting any security vulnerabilities or safety hazards on school property.
  • Professionalism: Cultivate inclusive and equitable working relationships with staff and community members while maintaining strict confidentiality regarding safety and security matters.
  • Communication & Operations: Maintain continuous radio contact with event staff, custodians, and administration as needed. Track after-school program schedules and occupancy across the facility.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Provide regular verbal updates to the administration responsible for activities and athletics regarding security incidents, policy violations, or operational concerns that impact campus safety or facility maintenance. Written reports will be provided quarterly and as needed.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities

  • Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with staff, visitors, and first responders.
  • Ability to exercise sound independent judgment and maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with school and district personnel and maintain organizational relationships.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with staff, visitors, and students.
  • Ability to walk, stand, and move quickly throughout a multi-story campus for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs.
  • Ability to sit at a monitoring station for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to describe problems and work orally or in writing to supervisor as needed.
  • Knowledge and experience with security software (camera systems and two-way radio equipment).
  • Demonstrate organization and time management skills.

Education/Certification/Qualifications Profile

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of prior experience in security, law enforcement, military, or school operations preferred.
  • Must hold a valid driver's license.
  • Must possess or be able to obtain a valid Red Cross First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)/AED Certificate or equivalent.
  • Must complete district-approved ALICE training.

EQUIPMENT: Use standard office equipment such as personal computers, printer, copier and fax machines and telephone. Use security specific technology.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work in a standard school building environment.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENT: No travel anticipated

SUPERVISOR: School Safety, Security and Emergency Preparedness Coordinator

JOB CATEGORY AND WORK CALENDAR: Non-Bargaining, Calendar 5600 (211 days). Hours on non-student attendance days would be different than hours on student attendance days.

FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt

RATE OF PAY: $23.00 - $36.18/hour

BENEFITS: Benefit information can be found here: Benefit Package 12 month non-exempt

SELECTION PROCEDURE: Qualified candidates will be contacted by the appropriate building administrator.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Paid Training
  • The privilege of having both paid holidays and Paid Time Off

Elevate your career with our innovative training programs

Job Overview:

The Seasonal Automated Warehouse Package Handler is responsible for completing customer orders. They do so by taking necessary items and quantities as mentioned on a pick ticket or a computer screen. Upon taking these items, they place them on a designated conveyor or pallet. Their performance must meet the company's regulations with due consideration for safety, accuracy, and efficiency.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assisting in the selection and handling of items in an automated environment involves using sophisticated machinery, software applications, and computers while following CCCI's established safety policies and procedures. Your multi-tasking skills, coupled with a quick decision-making ability, are invaluable in such a noisy and demanding environment.
  • Facilitates reliable warehouse procedures through team collaboration.
  • Exhibits versatility in adjusting to the requirements of the role by staying informed about the different work sections within the facility and satisfying the minimum performance criteria of each section, including but not limited to, HQS, Semi-Automated Lanes, Flow Rack, and Pallet Pick.
  • Ensuring that the warehouse functions without complications, you will assist in maintaining a hygienic environment by keeping your workstation free from refuse and clutter, mopping up any drips or spills that occur, and following the waste management and recycling practices as required.
  • Adheres to secure, accurate, and proficient protocols to regulate warehouse inventory and prevent shrinkage from exceeding acceptable levels.
  • To keep a warehouse running efficiently in a constantly changing environment, performs miscellaneous tasks as assigned.

  • Possessing the capability to perform in a swift atmosphere while walking and recurrently hoisting 30 lbs.
  • Aptitude to handle items weighing up to 75 pounds.
  • The aptitude to team up with others in a collaborative surrounding is a valuable ability.
  • Capable of streamlining and systematizing warehouse operations to promote efficiency and dependability.
  • The flexibility to adapt to the needs of different work domains and fulfill the minimum requirements of each area.
  • The aptitude to read and understand instructions shown on a computer display.
  • The capability to be meticulous and to distinguish our packages is of great importance.
  • Proficiency to work in an environment that lacks temperature control with high levels of noise.
  • Someone who is self-directed and continuously looks for ways to add value without being prompted.
  • A work environment that can adjust to meet the changing demands of the industry is referred to as flexibility.
  • The use of screens, monitors, and devices is a crucial aspect of performing accurate picking while adhering to a specific order.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • The experience gathered within the first three years of work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Having a high school diploma or GED signals to employers that an individual has acquired basic knowledge, skills, and competencies.

Work Environment:

  • This location presents challenges for workers, as it lacks proper temperature control and experiences high levels of noise.

Our company takes pride in being an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer, which means that we treat all candidates fairly and equally, regardless of their background, gender, ethnicity, or religion.

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Adhere to all safety policies and protocols to establish a safe work environment.
  • Engage in safety training programs to enhance your performance capabilities in a swiftly moving warehouse environment.
  • Handle the packaging, transportation, and distribution of goods for consumers and stores.
  • Ensure the meticulous management of products for retail fulfillment and customer drop-offs.
  • Ensure the smooth transportation of goods and effective inventory handling throughout the warehouse.
  • Make sure your workspace is clutter-free, organized, and clean at all times.
  • Timely attendance at work is crucial, along with accurately completing tasks as scheduled.
  • Work on addressing issues to foster continuous operational improvements.
  • Express a proactive and polite attitude when carrying out responsibilities independently or as a team member.

Requirements:

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Proficiency in maintaining an upright position, navigating, applying force, dragging, crouching, flexing, and extending during working hours.
  • Sustain a positive and professional approach whether in a team or independent work setting.
  • Core math competencies that entail counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Competency in accurately comprehending and interpreting information found on labels, tickets, and other product-related documents.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in operating computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision following appropriate training.
  • Proficient in expressing thoughts verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to understand, converse in, and interpret English to follow safety guidelines, policies, and instructions effectively.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficient in following instructions and utilizing powered machinery safely (e.g., Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Experienced in working safely at heights of up to 40 feet whenever necessary.
  • Experienced in operating effectively in temperature-managed environments, such as refrigerators and freezers, over long periods.

jobs.title: Security Shift Supervisors - Part Time
jobs.description:
Titan Security is built on serving our clients and building careers – just like yours. We are trusted by some of the most well-known companies and properties in the country while remaining dedicated to building personalized security solutions that solve the needs of every customer we support. Named as a nationally recognized Top Workplace in 2024 and 2025 by USA Today, Titan's customized approach to security services will provide you with the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed. Our core values of being Unified, Transparent, Innovative, Committed and Accountable help us in providing unparalleled service and support in all that we do. If you are looking for a meaningful career, a culture of excellence, and the ability to make a difference, we want to talk to you!

We are hiring Part Time Shift Supervisor to work at two Out Door Public Venues in the Downtown Loop area of Chicago. Ideal candidates must be available to work all shifts and must be available to work weekends. Hours are 1pm-9pm, 2pm-10pm or 3pm-11pm Friday/Saturday and Sunday

Responsibilities:

  • Help supervise operations of an assigned Client site on assigned shift.
  • Report directly to Site Supervisor/Director and/or Marksman / Titan Management.
  • Manage a team of security officers, including participating in scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support.
  • Ensure the Client Site is provided with high quality security services to protect people and property.
  • Handle all escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately.
  • Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, recognition, etc.).
  • Provide the basis of a great work environment by treating staff with respect.
  • Assist in the Coordination and/or conduct site-specific “on the job training”, client–specific training and annual refresher training for staff by adhering to Titan’s training standards.
  • Reconcile logs, shift responsibilities and patrols; review incident reports prior to submitting to Site Supervisor and/or Director and coordinate preliminary investigations.
  • Develop/maintain operational procedures and post orders that are always available for emergency reference by staff.
  • Train and qualify to work assigned post. Understands the specific and general post instructions for that assigned post. Maintain practical knowledge of all additional and emergency post instructions that are called for by the client.
  • Maintain access control procedures set by building management.
  • Effectively utilize access control systems, visitor management systems and CCTV systems as needed.
  • Identify all tenants and/or visitors upon arrival.
  • Ensure visitors and vendors are properly signed in prior to accessing the building.
  • Observe departing personnel to guard against theft of tenant or building property.
  • Monitor security cameras that are within the facility.
  • Respond to incidents including property emergencies.
  • Conduct general patrols of the entire property during various hours, if required, including numerous flights of stairs and frequent patrols of the exterior in any weather conditions.
  • Ability to stand/sit/walk for extended periods of time.
  • Assist tenants and visitors with directions and general business information.
  • Clearly and accurately record data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of equipment, to building and Titan management.
  • Maintain clear, accurate logs pertaining to people or property including packages.
  • Provide excellent Customer Service to all parties encountered while on duty.
  • Other duties as assigned.

***These positions require at least 1 year of continuous supervisory experience.***

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience: High School diploma or general education degree (GED) and 3 years prior satisfactory employment as a security officer or directly related experience. Must be at least 18 years of age.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Valid Security License if required by state, driver’s license as applicable.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Bi-lingual considered a plus.

Other Qualifications: Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check. Must maintain a working telephone number though which we can contact you.

Physical Demands: The physical demands are based on the contract and must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. A list of these job duties is inclusive of, but not limited to: candidates must be able to stand for extended periods of time; be able to lift, push, and/or pull at least 50 lbs.; be able to accommodate foot patrols on the interior & exterior of the assigned facility; be able to perform assigned duties regardless of inclement weather.

Pay and Benefits of Security Supervisors:

  • $22.60 / hour
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Medical and Dental insurance
  • Opportunities for career growth and promotion
  • Skills-enhancing training

jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment

Alice & Wonder | Chicago, IL 60642
Starting at $17.50/hour

About the Role

Alice & Wonder is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associate to join our Chicago warehouse team.

This position is primarily responsible for picking, packing, tagging, and preparing merchandise for our retail stores and online customers.

We're looking for someone who works efficiently, pays attention to the little details, and enjoys being part of a fast-moving team. You'll spend your day working with our products—picking merchandise, tagging clothing, preparing store transfers, packing online orders, checking product quality, and making sure orders leave our warehouse accurately and looking great.

Accuracy and productivity are the two biggest priorities in this role.

What You'll Do

Picking, Packing & Store Fulfillment

  • Pick merchandise accurately for store transfers and customer orders
  • Scan, pack, and prepare inventory transfers for our retail locations
  • Verify styles, sizes, colors, and quantities before orders are completed
  • Keep orders organized throughout the fulfillment process
  • Help ensure stores receive the right merchandise on time

Online Order Fulfillment

  • Pick and pack online customer orders accurately and efficiently
  • Inspect merchandise before packing to ensure it meets our quality standards
  • Prepare packages for shipment
  • Make sure orders are neat, accurate, and presentation-ready
  • Gift-wrap customer orders when requested

Tagging & Product Preparation

  • Tag and label clothing, accessories, and other incoming merchandise
  • Prepare new merchandise so it is ready for our stores and customers
  • Organize product by style, size, or designated inventory location
  • Identify damaged, defective, or incorrect merchandise
  • Communicate product or inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Lead

Warehouse Support

  • Help count and verify incoming merchandise
  • Assist with inventory counts as needed
  • Restock and organize picking and packing areas
  • Keep your workstation and surrounding warehouse areas clean and organized
  • Work closely with warehouse, shipping, retail, and other teams
  • Pitch in with other warehouse tasks when needed

What We're Looking For

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant 2 - Seasonal
jobs.description:
Position Overview | The Big Picture

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for moving, storing, covering, and preparing props and furniture for warehouse storage or into bins for delivery. The Warehouse Assistant reports to the Warehouse Manager and may take direction from the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Warehouse Lead.


Our Mission Values | Our Commitments

Each employee works together to strive to create the best design company by improving communication, showing genuine care for each other and the company, focusing on delivering quality, and demonstrating professionalism through personal excellence, with a shared passion, dedication, and commitment to providing exceptional value to our clients.

Traits for Success | #hardworker
  • Safety-minded
  • Team player.
  • Great Listener.
  • Steady worker.
  • Good with hands.


Essential Duties | What You’ll Do – The Fun Stuff

  • Learns inventory and pull sheets to successfully fill event orders.
  • Prepares props and furniture for events to include but not limited to: wrapping fabric and vinyl, drilling holes, nailing, hammering, hand and spray painting, polishing, cleaning and staining.
  • Wraps furniture and props for delivery; unwraps inventory as needed.
  • Cleans and sweeps work space to ensure workspace is organized, safe and free from obstacles and debris.
  • Warehouse Assistant levels 2 and 3 perform increasingly more complex and detailed prop and warehouse work and require less supervision.

Other Duties and Safety Requirements | There’s More!
  • Complies with all department and company safety guidelines, procedures, and rules.
  • Mentors safe work practices to co-workers and team.
  • Completes all safety training as directed and within established timelines.
  • Interfaces professionally with all people, internal and external, in a kind and respectful manner.
  • Tracks and enters time and assigns hours and tasks to appropriate events and jobs in time and attendance system.
  • Completes all Human Resources and Payroll tasks and notifications through the Employee Self Service Online Portal on a weekly basis, as directed and within established timelines.
  • Assists in other departments as needed and directed.
  • May perform other duties as required.

Qualifications | What You Need to Bring
  • Ability to understand, read and speak simple English.
  • Good verbal communication skills to communicate successfully with the Warehouse team.
  • Ability to interpret pull sheets.
  • Familiarity with proper packing methods is helpful.
  • Must be able to provide the following tools for use during the work shift: wire cutter and utility knife.
  • Good knowledge and ability to use tools and equipment that may include: hammer, screwdriver, hand drill, tape measure, dollies, and 8 foot and 12 foot ladders.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules to include evenings and weekends.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements | What it is Like in the Shop
  • Ability to stand, kneel, crouch, bend and reach during entire work shift.
  • Able to walk 30% of the work shift.
  • Ability to work with hands and arms during entire shift.
  • Must be able to move and climb ladders without accommodation.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push and pull 30-40 lbs. throughout the shift. Occasionally may move up to and over 100 lbs. with assistance.
  • Ability to handle fragile items safely.
  • Must have 20/20 vision with correction.
  • Must be able to tolerate cold, heat and humid conditions.
  • May be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and chemicals throughout the work shift.
  • Ability to tolerate moderate noise.


Pay & Benefits | What You’ll Receive

  • Hourly wage: $18.00 to $22.00 based on experience.
  • Overtime pay will be provided for hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek at 1.5x the regular rate of pay, in compliance with Illinois labor laws.
  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options available full-time.
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company matching.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): In compliance with Illinois State Law.
  • Training & Development: Opportunities for skill development and career advancement.

Other Benefits

  • Flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend availability.
  • Safe and supportive work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:
Kehoe Designs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Material Handler / Forklift Operator
jobs.description:
At Graphic Packaging International, we produce the paper cup that held your coffee this morning, the basket that transported those bottles of craft beer you enjoyed last weekend, and the microwave tray that heated your gourmet meal last night. We’re one of the largest manufacturers of paperboard and paper-based packaging for some of the world’s most recognized brands of food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care and pet products. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, we are collaborative, diverse, innovative individuals who create inspired packaging while giving back to our communities.

With over 25,000 employees working in more than 130 locations worldwide, we strive to be environmentally responsible in our industry and in the communities where we operate. We are committed to workplace diversity and offer compensation and benefits programs that are among the industry’s best to reward the talented people who make our company successful.

If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, we’d love to hear from you.

A World of Difference. Made Possible.

OPPORTUNITY: We are a Food service folding carton manufacturing operation seeking candidates to join our Chicago IL team. We’re recruiting for multiple positions so be sure you review all of our job postings. This job posting is for a Shipping – Receiving associate with a pay range of $21.91 to $25.36 /hour plus shift differential and progressive pay increases. We continually encourage our employees to advance their careers through on the job training and job progression through our strong promotion from within program. We offer a wide array of benefits including, but not limited to, Paid Vacation & Holidays, optional Health, Dental, and Life Insurance, including health spending accounts and a progressive healthy lifestyle program, as well as 401-K with a company matching component and standard supplemental company contributions. Employees may voluntarily elect Pet Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance Programs, Purchasing Power, Tuition Reimbursement, Aflac, Lifelock Identity Protection, and Hyatt Legal Services. Tobacco Cessation and Employee Assistance/Referral Program, Uniform Service, Safety Shoe, and Safety Prescription-Eyewear benefits are also available.

JOB SUMMARY: The person who occupies this position is responsible for shipping, receiving coordinating traffic, warehousing inventories, communications and producing product and any other items as they relate to shipping out of or being received into the plant and warehouse locations.

JOB FUNCTIONS: Job functions include, but are not limited to the following.

A shipping material handler will spend approximately 70% of working shift on a forklift and 30% doing other shipping duties.

  • Know, understand and follow all plant and department safety requirements.
  • Maintain a safe and clean environment inside and outside of the facility.
  • Maintain equipment and do all required safety checks and cleanings as required.
  • Wrap loads and insure quality standards and checks are being completed this is insuring packing, wrapping, labeling and information is correct on outbound shipment of product.
  • Ship and Receive all product in and out of the plant location.
  • Insure all manifests, invoices, orders, shipping documentation, and forms are accurate.
  • Examine documents to insure outbound and incoming contents are accurate with paperwork of the shipment.
  • Prepare documents such as work orders, bills of ladings, packing slips and shipping orders.
  • Shuttle product from the facility to outside warehousing as need with accurate billing and documentation for accurate inventories.
  • Record shipping data such as damages, rejected trailers, discrepancies for reporting, accounting and recordkeeping purposes.
  • Determine shipping methods and procedures for safe shipment based on the material using shipping knowledge and procedures.
  • Deliver or rout incoming material or equipment to the appropriate departments.
  • Confer and correspond with representatives to rectify problems such as shortage of material, late trucks, quality issues and nonconformance to specifications. This will include but is not limited to the warehouse, other shifts, production departments, corporate transportation, quality departments, safety manager or any supervision of the plant.
  • Communicating with Supervisors, Peers and Subordinates to insure all issues are communicated properly.
  • Store, maintain and monitor shipping materials and supplies used for shipping.
  • Contact corporate shipping (TMS) or supervision when needed to insure scheduled inbound and outbound reach their destinations as scheduled to meet the needs of the customer and our facilities.
  • Compute weights and pallet amounts to insure trailers are loaded properly and not detained over the road.
  • Load product on shipments and shuttles to insure scheduled load times are being met by our facility and the warehouse along with scheduled delivery time of product.
  • Process customer returns and validate all incoming product.
  • Use, know and understand all computer programs and technical skills used at the facility in the shipping and inventory function.
  • Pull PO from file, sign and verify physical delivery of goods.
  • Pull packing slip from goods and validate receipt.
  • Audit packing slip against PO to determine if delivery received is complete
  • Unpack deliveries; verify product received against PO item and quantity. Receive items in SAP. Pull PO (or reprint) and assemble w/packing slip for GR for 3-way filing.
  • Process chemical deliveries consist with established protocol.
  • Act as the backup for all plant subcontracting.
  • Backfill material handler position (breaks, lunches, vacations etc.)

Background / Experience / Skills

  • Manufacturing experience preferred
  • Must have physical coordination to operate forklift.
  • Use of Machines, Tools, Equipment, Software:
    • Forklifts (Reach Truck experience needed)
    • Radio and Communication devices
    • Bar code reader
    • E-Mail communications.
    • SAP
    • PEAK
    • Phone-Two way communications
    • Fax
  • Know, understand and pass all needed skill level matrix
  • Know and understand SAP application in regards to inventory, production and shipments.
  • Know and understand all shipping protocol and procedures.
  • Must have reasoning ability to identify alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.
Education / Knowledge

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • English speaking, reading and writing skills and comprehension- This is needed to insure proper shipping, receiving and computer programs are used to insure proper and legal documentation and processes are followed. This will include the need to be able to understand written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents and programs. It includes conveying information to the needed parties and writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.
  • The knowledge and understanding of meeting both internal and external customer needs. Servicing the customers and vendors in a professional manner while supplying prompt delivery and receiving of products to and from the facility.

Schedule Requirements

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Unarmed Security Officer to uphold safety and security across our premises. Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Guard Full Time Unarmed Patrol Observer in Houston, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Government, and more. As an unarmed Patrol Officer at a government location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support a welcoming environment for employees and visitors. You will provide exceptional customer service, communicate clearly, and respond to security-related concerns with professionalism. jobs.description:
Description

Ready for more than just a job? Build a career with purpose.

At Lactalis in the USA, we’re committed to providing meaningful opportunities for our people to learn, grow, and thrive—whether you’re just starting your journey with us or looking to take the next step in your career. From day one, we offer the tools and support to help you succeed.

As the world leader in dairy, Lactalis is a family-owned company with over 85,000 pragmatic and ambitious professionals across the globe. Each day, we’re proud to produce award-winning dairy products that bring people together.

In the US, we proudly offer an unrivaled house of beloved brands, including Galbani® Italian cheeses and ricotta, Président® specialty cheeses and butters, Kraft® natural and grated cheeses, Breakstone’s® cottage cheese, Cracker Barrel®, Black Diamond® cheddar, and Parmalat® milk. Our yogurt portfolio includes siggi’s®, Stonyfield Organic®, Brown Cow™, Oui®, Yoplait®, Go-Gurt®, :ratio®, Green Mountain Creamery®, and Mountain High®, along with a growing family of ethnic favorites like Karoun®, Gopi®, and Arz®.

At Lactalis, we live by our core values—Ambition, Engagement, and Simplicity. We foster a workplace where innovation thrives, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone’s unique background and ideas are valued.

Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We want to hear about your PASSION, your STORY, and how your EXPERTISE can help us shape the future of dairy.

From your PASSION to ours

Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Sr. Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems based in Chicago, IL. As a Sr Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems, the role will carry out responsibilities such as supporting technical solution design, configuration support, integrations, enhancements, testing, deployment, and production support for Blue Yonder WM and related SAP-enabled Supply Chain Execution processes. The role includes working on Functional, technical specifications, interfaces, APIs, data mapping, reporting, troubleshooting, and integration with SAP Inventory Management, Materials Management, Sales/Distribution, Transportation, and Manufacturing processes. Additionally, the Technical Analyst will collaborate with functional analysts, business stakeholders, IT integration teams, and external partners to deliver stable, scalable solutions aligned with company goals and values.

Requirements

From your EXPERTISE to ours

Key Responsibilities For This Position Include

  • Strong hands-on Blue Yonder WM technical experience primarily in “Warehouse Management and Supply Chain Execution” processes.
  • Experience in integrating ERP/Host systems with Blue Yonder’s Warehouse Management Systems
  • Partner with functional analysts and business users to understand requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
  • Develop, support, and troubleshoot technical objects such as interfaces, reports, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, integrations, and data extracts related to Blue Yonder WM.
  • Support system integrations between Blue Yonder WM to SAP ECC, middleware(Go Anywhere), EDI, APIs transportation, manufacturing, and third-party logistics applications.
  • Analyze BY interface failures, application errors, data mapping issues, transaction processing defects, and performance bottlenecks; document root cause and corrective actions.
  • Support API usage, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting for inbound, outbound, and internal warehouse processes.
  • Participate in system configuration reviews, technical impact assessments, design walkthroughs, unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Prepare and maintain technical design documents, interface mapping documents, test evidence, cutover tasks, deployment checklists, and production support knowledge articles.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional IT teams, business process owners, and project teams to resolve integration and application issues.
  • Support large-scale BY WMS implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and legacy WMS replacement initiatives.
  • Ensure technical solutions follow IT standards for documentation, controls, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Provide hypercare and production support for Blue Yonder WM incidents, enhancement requests, and operational issues.
  • Comfortable working alongside business analysts and functional teams who provide requirements.
  • Experience with using / Testing APIs.
  • Experience in working with Native SaaS WMS solutions.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience working within Blue Yoder’s Warehouse Management Systems either as a customer of Blue Yonder or as a consultant implementing Blue Yonder solutions for customers.
  • Additionally relevant solutions consulting and implementation experience with other leading supply chain planning solutions such as SAP WM, Infolog is a plus.

From your STORY to ours

Qualified Applicants Will Contribute The Following

  • Bachelor's degree is required in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics / Operations Management, or related field.
  • Preferred Blue Yonder WMS Technical Accreditation/certified.
  • 3+ years Strong Technical Experience in Blue Yonder Warehouse Management System is required.
  • Hands-on BY Warehouse Management process and integration with SAP ECC System (application and configuration) for global project implementations; food industry experience preferred.
  • Ensure Warehouse Process business requirements across Supply Chain Area and related functions are translated into detailed functional specifications.
  • Configure and test system processes; troubleshoot, document, and resolve system-related issues.

Certifications and specific knowledge

  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder Warehouse Management Processes is required.
  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder WM inbound, outbound, internal warehouse process and integration with transportation, manufacturing and SAP ECC system is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points and techniques with SAP system and logistics, as well as 3rd party applications is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points with SAP modules such as Invenorty Management, Procurement, Sales and Transportation planning are required.

We support insurance costs significantly, contribute generously to retirement plans, and offer Paid Time Off from day one. We are committed to your professional growth, providing training and development opportunities, including Education Reimbursement. Join us and grow your career.

Further, any division of the Company that is an Affirmative Action Employer will comply with all related legal obligations.

jobs.title: Security Officer Armed - Security
jobs.via: via Women For Hire- Job Board
jobs.description:
Description

Summary:

Uniformed position at all times. Armed Security Officer’s duties include being a visible deterrent to criminal activity, providing security for patients, Associates, and visitors, protecting and patrolling hospital buildings, assets and premises as assigned. The Armed Security Officer is responsible for responding to all emergency codes, internal/external disaster events as needed and/or requested, conducting preliminary investigations of reported incidents, and performing other security related tasks as directed by a security supervisor/and or Manager. The Armed Security Officer must have flexibility in hours and be able to rotate between facilities including travel whenever necessary. CHRISTUS Approved uniforms must be worn in accordance with dress code requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Meets expectations of the applicable OneCHRISTUS Competencies: Leader of Self, Leader of Others, or Leader of Leaders.
  • Conducts frequent security patrols of the facilities and grounds as assigned.
  • Identifies and reports trends related to security issues. Recommends actions.
  • Takes initial information for an incident report, uses proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, notes only the facts, leaving out personal opinions and submits report in a timely manner (no later than the end of assigned shift).
  • Responds promptly to all service requests relayed by supervisor, telephone, pass-on, e-mail, radio, cell phone and other correspondence in a courteous and expeditious manner.
  • Responds to the collection, inventory and return of lost and found items, patient valuables, and personal property according to policy.
  • Enforces all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of CHRISTUS Health and the laws of the state in which CHRISTUS is doing business.
  • Controls and enforces facility parking using patrols, violation warning citations, towing, booting and explanation of rules as applicable.
  • Assists clinical/non-clinical Associates with combative patients or visitors.
  • Demonstrates competence to perform assigned client care responsibilities in a way that meets the age-specific and developmental needs of persons served by the department.
  • Demonstrates proficiency and knowledge in the operation of the Attendant Console, Paging System, security radio/dispatch system, operations of the Digital Video Recorder (NVR) security monitors (CCTV) and the general overhead paging system.
  • Must be proficient with the use of a PC to generate electronic daily activity security reports, incident reports, emails and other applicable electronic correspondence during the performance of duties.
  • Promotes a safe environment by reporting safety hazards observed (broken water/sprinkler lines, burned out internal/external lighting, smoke/gas odors, tripping hazards, etc.) during the performance of security rounds.
  • Appropriately adapts assigned client assessment, treatment and/or care methods to accommodate the physical, cultural, age-specific, and other developmental needs of each person served.
  • Demonstrated competence with handgun, hand cuffs, baton, non-crisis intervention certification and two-way radios.
  • Frequent exposure to aggressive behavior and emotionally charged situations.
  • Occasional exposure to hazardous conditions such as fires, chemical spills, and flooding.
  • Frequent exposure to heat and cold from external weather conditions.
  • Long periods of walking, standing, stooping, and lifting.
  • Must be physically fit and able to walk all areas of the facilities and grounds, to restrain those who need restraint and be able to assist nursing staff with lifting patients of all sizes.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Must be always mentally alert.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be able to make immediate decisions regarding laws, policies, and procedures.
  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks and prioritize.
  • Must be able to handle personal stress and possible violence.

Job Requirements:

Education/Skills

  • High School Diploma or its equivalent required

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years of armed security experience (may substituted by Honorable Military Service) preferred
  • Law enforcement experience preferred
  • Healthcare security experience preferred

Licenses, Registrations, or Certifications

  • Verbal De-escalation training must be completed within 60 days of hire
  • BLS required within 60 days of hire
  • Expandable Baton training, defensive tactics training, firearms training, weapon qualification, and firearms retention training must be completed prior to letter of authorization to carry is issued
  • Successful completion of all pre-employment and post offer assessments to include the Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory -2 (MMPI-2-RF-PCIR); the California Psychological Inventory (CPI); the Police and Public Safety Selection Report (PPSSR); the Personal Experience Inventory (PEI) and a clinical interview by a third personal psychologist
  • Will be required to take random drug test screening
  • Valid Driver's license required
  • Candidates must maintain an acceptable driving record to meet CHRISTUS Health standards for positions requiring driving. An unacceptable record includes, but is not limited to:
    • One or more moving violations within a 12-month period.
    • One or more chargeable accidents within a 12-month period. Chargeable means the driver is determined to be the primary cause of the accident.
    • Contributing factors such as weather or mechanical issues will be considered.
    • Any combination of accidents and/or moving violations.
    • Violations include any ticket, charge, or other law enforcement proceeding related to these, as well as independent evidence of violations deemed relevant by CHRISTUS Health Security.
  • For Texas positions:
    • Must hold an active Level 3 Commission with the Texas Department of Public Safety Private Security Bureau (TDPSPSB).
    • New hires who have completed the TDPSPSB security commission course must obtain their commission prior to hire.
    • If the license status is ACTIVE in TOPS and the pocket card has not yet been received, the licensee may begin working.
    • Until the pocket card is received, the licensee must carry proof of ACTIVE status (e.g., screenshot or printed copy from TOPS) while on duty.
  • For New Mexico positions:
    • Officers may not carry a weapon on duty until completing 40 hours of training and receiving a letter of authorization from the CHRISTUS Vice President of Security to carry a CHRISTUS Health-assigned weapon.
  • For Louisiana positions:
    • Officers may not carry a weapon on duty until completing 40 hours of training and receiving a letter of authorization from the CHRISTUS Vice President of Security to carry a CHRISTUS Health-assigned weapon.

In accordance with the CHRISTUS Health License, Certification and Registration Verification Policy, all Associates are required to obtain the required certifications for their respective positions within the designated time frame.

Work Schedule:

6AM - 6PM 12 HR Shift

Work Type:

Full Time

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Compliance in Houston, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $16.38 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeSat09:30 AM - 05:30 PM

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Role Based in West Chicago

Role Essentials

  • Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate (Flexible Hours in West Chicago)
  • Location: West Chicago, IL
  • Hiring: UPS
  • This West Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in West Chicago, IL is growing.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Earnings: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $26.7k/Year)
  • Benefits: Employee discounts and perks (where applicable).
  • Excellent work-life balance in West Chicago.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible West Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Fast Facts

  • Part-Time Opportunity in Chicago: Receiving Associate

  • Benefits: Weekly pay options may be available.

Day-to-Day

  • This role focuses on your professional skills with a schedule that fits your life.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

If you are searching for UPS warehouse jobs that align perfectly with a daytime school schedule or a morning-shift primary job, our twilight sort operation — typically running 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM — is the ideal entry into one of America's most respected logistics careers. These warehouse jobs come with full union representation and real long-term potential.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The twilight shift fits my life perfectly. I go to class in the morning, work at UPS in the evening, and my tuition is being covered by Earn & Learn. The shift itself is fast and the team is incredibly motivated — everyone knows we have a hard window to hit and we go after it together. These are the best UPS warehouse jobs for students, hands down." - Current Twilight Warehouse Associate, Chicago, IL.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate, you process the peak commercial pickup volume of the day during the evening sort window. You will rotate through loading, sorting, and unloading functions as directed by your sort manager within our package center.

  • Commercial Pickup Processing: Sort the high-density commercial package volume collected from business pickups during the day, routing each parcel accurately onto outbound belts and trailers for overnight transport.
  • Multi-Function Rotation: Work fluidly across unloading, sorting, and loading assignments as the twilight sort manager redistributes labor to balance throughput across the facility's busiest evening hours.
  • Sort Accuracy Compliance: Maintain UPS's required sort accuracy rate by carefully verifying destination labels and barcode scans before releasing any package onto an outbound conveyor.

Benefits & Perks

Twilight Warehouse Associates receive Teamsters union wages with annual progression raises, medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition program. The evening shift window makes this one of the most student-friendly warehouse jobs in the market.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Manager, Contractor Special Access Program Security Officer (CSSO), you will be responsible for the management of accredited SAPFs and SCIFs, manage all security aspects of classified government contract programs and operations, lead self-inspections and security education programs to ensure security compliance, and work with internal and external partners to determine a mitigation strategy for any instances of non-compliance.

Implement all requisite national security directives with specific emphasis on DoD 5205.07 SAP Security Manual, ICD 705 and exhibit the dedication and expectation of a seasoned security professional while working and making decisions independently without direct supervision.


** This is an onsite position in Richardson, TX. **

What YOU will do:

  • Professionally and effectively interface with program managers and government officials to obtain rulings, interpretations, and acceptable deviations or waivers for compliance with regulations.

  • Implement and ensure compliance with the DoD Manual 5205.07, 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM Rule), Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs), and related Industrial Security Guidance Manuals or Special Program Security directives.

  • Make decisions and provide timely inputs that impact critical goals and objectives of the business.

  • Review contractual (SOW, CDRL, etc.) documents, internal directives, and external customer directives for security applicability, impact analysis, and make recommendations to Program Management.

  • Perform duties as the SAP-AO (Accountability Officer).

  • Provide oversight of security related Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), OPSEC Plans,

  • Program Protection Plans (PPP), Program Protection Implementation Plans (PPIP).

  • Partner with cross functional organizations to support business objectives.

  • Implement a self-inspection program to include evaluating findings and directing the implementation and re-evaluation of the corrective action(s).

  • Prepare, submit and receive area/facility accreditation approvals

  • Lead the team in Government security compliance inspections.

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.

Across the country, tens of thousands of UPS associates treat their evening sort shift as a second job that generates an additional $800 to $1,200 per month in take-home income — income that pays off debt, funds vacations, builds emergency savings, and accelerates financial goals that a single income never could. jobs.description:
At Nebraska Furniture Mart (NFM), we’ve been hiring friends since 1937—people who share our passion for helping customers feel right at home. If you share our vision, we invite you to be one of us! People love working here! Named one of Furniture Today’s Best places to work, and here a few reasons why: A FUN, stable work environment, with no layoffs in our history. A safe place to work and shop, development opportunities leading you to the career of your dreams and a culture that encourages volunteering and serving our communities.

Pay Range: $18.01 - $21.88 hourly

Job Description: Your Piece of the Puzzle

NFM is looking for a Security Officer to provide an authoritative presence to ensure a safe and secure environment, while protecting company property and staff.

Job Duties: A Day in the Life

  • Greet: Welcome all customers, visitors and vendors and assist them in locating staff within the stores
  • Support: Issue electric handicapped shopping carts to customers and provide assistance in obtaining wheel chairs and shopping carts
  • Monitor: Examine and properly tag property being brought into the stores
  • Assess: React as necessary and assist in handling any situations – shoplifting, medical emergencies and inclement weather
  • Patrol: Watch facilities and parking areas on foot or in a vehicle. Direct traffic during special events or heavy customer traffic, while enforcing parking regulations
  • Assist: Help customers and staff with vehicle break-downs and lock-outs and retrieve shopping carts from parking areas
  • Report: Conduct preliminary investigations, audits and security surveys and document the findings

Your work will directly impact our ability to help people create a lifestyle they love, for the people they love—because that’s what we love.

  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record
  • Ability to consistently engage customers in a professional manner
  • Remain flexible to ever changing environments and adapt to different situations
  • Stamina to stand for long periods of time
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications
  • Certification in OC (Oleoresin Capsicum) foam deployment within one (1) year of employment and maintain certification standards (Nebraska & Kansas only)
