Job Summary:

Target's employees benefit from diverse growth programs designed to help them grow both personally and professionally. Working toward Target's goals and values creates a more productive and motivating work environment.

Roles and Duties:

  • Follow all safety guidelines and procedures to guarantee the safety of all personnel in the workplace.
  • Attend safety training classes to get certified and acquire the necessary skills to work seamlessly and safely in a fast-paced warehouse.
  • Guarantee the prompt delivery of merchandise by packing, loading, and shipping items to retail stores and guests.
  • Maintain the accuracy of our merchandise processing to ensure timely and efficient delivery to our retail locations and clientele.
  • Perform warehouse tasks expeditiously and without endangering the safety of yourself or others while handling freight and inventory.
  • Consistently maintaining a neat and clean work area is an important aspect of promoting workplace health and wellness.
  • Being punctual at work and carrying out assigned tasks with precision and timeliness are essential for job performance.
  • With a focus on problem solving and a commitment to continuous improvement, organizations can increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall performance. By prioritizing problem solving, companies can achieve sustainable success in today's dynamic business environment
  • Remains amicable and professional when executing responsibilities alone or working with colleagues.

Requirements:

  • Able to handle and move merchandise weighing between 35-50 pounds repeatedly during a workday.
  • Able to lift and convey goods weighing up to 60 pounds from time to time during their shift.
  • Carry out work duties that demand regular standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching actions.
  • Demonstrate a positive and courteous demeanor when working independently or in a team atmosphere.
  • Possessing the capability to accurately execute rudimentary math operations, to include counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Demonstrating the talent to effectively read and understand the information on product documentation, labels, and tickets.
  • With the right training, individuals can become skilled in operating computer systems and handheld devices, requiring minimal guidance.
  • To be an effective communicator, you must be able to convey your thoughts and ideas clearly, concisely, and in a way that is easily understood by your audience
  • Complying with safety guidelines, procedures, and instructions is imperative to ensure workplace safety, and this necessitates an adequate level of proficiency in reading, speaking, and comprehending English.

Additional Requirements:

  • Adept at carrying out all activities related to powered equipment securely, including Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down & Standup Forklift, and competent in working at heights of up to 40ft when applicable.
  • Complete work assignments while standing on a mezzanine level, which could reach a height of up to 40 ft, whenever appropriate
  • Skilled at managing tasks while working in temperature-controlled environments, including refrigeration and freezing units, for the majority of the work period.

jobs.description:
Job DetailsJob Location: Central Texas  - Austin, TX 78744Position Type: Full TimeEducation Level: CollegeTravel Percentage: NoneJob Shift: DayJob Category: Human Resources5 STAR EVENT SERVICES 

Recruiting & Hiring Manager 

Central Texas | Austin, Texas Area 


	
		
			
			Job Title 
			
			
			Recruiting & Hiring Manager 
			
		
		
			
			Department 
			
			
			Human Resources / Operations / Personnel 
			
		
		
			
			Location 
			
			
			Central Texas, Austin, Texas Area 
			
		
		
			
			Reports To 
			
			
			Director of Operations, Branch Manager, HR leadership, or designated company leadership 
			
		
		
			
			Schedule 
			
			
			Full-time; flexible schedule required, including recruiting events, evenings, weekends, holidays, and event support as business needs require 
			
		
		
			
			Role Type 
			
			
			Office-based with regular recruiting, onboarding, and event-site support 
			
		
	


Position Summary 

The Recruiting & Hiring Manager is responsible for recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and workforce pipeline development for 5 STAR Event Services’ Central Texas operations. This role ensures the company has a steady flow of qualified, properly screened, event-ready employees to meet client commitments and operational staffing needs. 

The ideal candidate is people-focused, organized, proactive, and comfortable communicating with applicants, new hires, employees, supervisors, managers, and the corporate team. This position requires strong judgment, urgency, follow-through, and the ability to balance hiring volume with quality, compliance, employee experience, and operational readiness. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

Recruiting, Hiring, and Workforce Pipeline 


	
	Manage the full-cycle recruiting process for hourly event staff and security personnel, including job postings, applicant communication, interview coordination, hiring follow-up, and onboarding handoff. 
	



	
	Create, update, and maintain job advertisements that accurately reflect event staffing, security, and operational roles. 
	



	
	Screen applicants for availability, communication skills, professionalism, reliability, licensing requirements, and role fit. 
	



	
	Coordinate interviews, hiring events, job fairs, networking events, referral outreach, and community recruiting opportunities. 
	



	
	Initiate and monitor required pre-employment steps, including background checks, license requirements, eligibility review, paperwork completion, and onboarding readiness. 
	



	
	Maintain an active pipeline of qualified candidates to support high-volume event periods, seasonal demand, recurring venues, and urgent staffing needs. 
	



	
	Review former employees for rehire consideration in accordance with company rehire eligibility standards. 
	



	
	Communicate hiring trends, candidate flow, recruiting barriers, and staffing pipeline concerns to leadership on a regular basis. 
	



	
	Partner with scheduling and operations leadership to understand upcoming staffing needs and prioritize recruiting accordingly. 
	


Onboarding and New Employee Experience 


	
	Coordinate new employee onboarding, welcoming, documentation completion, licensing steps, orientation communication, and first-shift readiness. 
	



	
	Ensure new hires understand company expectations related to attendance, communication, uniform standards, professionalism, event readiness, and scheduling responsiveness. 
	



	
	Support initial placement of new employees based on availability, qualifications, location, skill set, and event needs. 
	



	
	Follow up with new hires during the early employment period to support retention, answer questions, and identify concerns quickly. 
	



	
	Maintain a professional, realistic, and welcoming candidate and new-hire experience consistent with 5 STAR’s culture and operational expectations. 
	


Employee Relations and Team Building 


	
	Build rapport with employees and understand their strengths, development areas, certifications, availability, event preferences, and placement fit. 
	



	
	Maintain open communication with Event Managers, supervisors, branch leadership, HR, and the 5 STAR corporate team. 
	



	
	Assist with office tasks, projects, and people-related follow-up, sometimes directly and sometimes indirectly, based on operational needs. 
	



	
	Assist Event Managers with deployment readiness and employee placement information when needed. 
	



	
	Promote company standards for reliability, professionalism, customer service, safety, teamwork, and respectful communication. 
	


Performance Management and Employee Records 


	
	Assist in maintaining accurate employee records, including availability, onboarding status, licensing status, and other personnel-related data. 
	



	
	Recommend employees for recognition, preferred assignments, advancement opportunities, coaching, or removal from certain assignments when appropriate. 
	


Systems, Compliance, and Reporting 


	
	Maintain accurate candidate, hiring, onboarding, and employee information in approved company systems. 
	



	
	Use Paycom, Celayix, Team XPress, applicant tracking tools, Microsoft Office, Outlook, and other approved systems to support hiring, onboarding, workforce tracking, and reporting. 
	



	
	Generate and share recruiting pipeline, applicant status, onboarding completion, licensing, hiring conversion, and retention reports as requested. 
	



	
	Identify process improvements that increase recruiting efficiency, candidate quality, onboarding consistency, compliance visibility, and new-hire retention. 
	


Equipment and Event Readiness Support 


	
	Assist with inventory control for uniforms, radios, credentials, and other equipment or supplies needed for new hires and event readiness. 
	



	
	Coordinate distribution, recovery, and tracking of company-issued items as needed. 
	



	
	Assist with event or venue uniform, equipment, food, and supply needs when requested by operations leadership. 
	


 

Authority and Decision-Making Responsibilities 

This role is expected to make timely hiring and onboarding decisions within established company policies while escalating higher-risk or policy-sensitive matters to leadership. The following outlines the general scope of authority: 


	
		
			
			Decision Level 
			
			
			Scope of Authority 
			
		
		
			
			May independently 
			
			
			Communicate with applicants and candidates, schedule interviews, conduct initial screening, coordinate onboarding steps, maintain candidate records, support job postings, and recommend qualified candidates for hiring based on established criteria. 
			
		
		
			
			May recommend 
			
			
			Hiring decisions, rehire eligibility review, recruiting priorities, candidate disposition, onboarding process improvements, employee recognition, coaching, preferred assignments, and candidate/source strategy. 
			
		
		
			
			Must escalate 
			
			
			Background check concerns, licensing concerns, questionable rehire eligibility, applicant conduct issues, candidate complaints, urgent hiring shortfalls, policy exceptions, wage or offer questions, and any compliance or legal concern. 
			
		
		
			
			Requires approval

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Investing in its employees is a top priority for Target. The company provides growth opportunities, mentorship, and professional development training to help them succeed in their careers.

Roles and Duties:

  • Act in accordance with safety policies and procedures to promote a safe and healthy working environment for all staff members.
  • Sign up for safety training programs that teach you on how to handle the fast-paced warehouse environment without compromising your safety.
  • As part of the delivery process, package, load, and transport products to retail locations and customers.
  • Make certain that the merchandise is accurately processed for distribution to our outlets and clients.
  • Execute warehouse activities securely and quickly while maintaining the flow of inventory.
  • A tidy and well-maintained workspace can improve your work efficiency and ensure optimal work output.
  • Be punctual in reporting to work and complete job duties as directed with accuracy and within the given timeline.
  • With a focus on problem solving and a commitment to continuous improvement, organizations can increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall performance. By prioritizing problem solving, companies can achieve sustainable success in today's dynamic business environment
  • Demonstrates a constructive and gracious attitude when working alone or collaborating with others.

Requirements:

  • Can lift and transport merchandise weighing 35-50 pounds on multiple occasions during a work shift.
  • Able to transport goods weighing up to 60 pounds from time to time throughout the workday.
  • Engage in tasks requiring standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching frequently and consistently in a work setting.
  • Demonstrate a positive and courteous demeanor when working independently or in a team atmosphere.
  • Adequately knowledgeable in utilizing basic math skills, encompassing counting, addition, and subtraction, with accuracy.
  • Having the talent to accurately read and understand the information presented on product labels, tickets, and documentation.
  • After receiving the necessary training, individuals can work effectively with computer systems and handheld devices without much assistance.
  • Effective communication proficiency is a vital tool that is essential to master in any organization or workplace
  • Effective communication and understanding of safety measures, guidelines, and training programs necessitate a competent level of English proficiency in reading, speaking, and listening.

Additional Requirements:

  • Adroit at operating all powered equipment safely while complying with safety procedures, including but not limited to Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down & Standup Forklift, and capable of working at heights of up to 40ft.
  • Execute work functions while positioned on a mezzanine level, which may reach a height of up to 40 ft, if necessary
  • Skilled at handling tasks within temperature-controlled areas, such as refrigerators and freezers, for extended periods of time.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Target's employees benefit from diverse growth programs designed to help them grow both personally and professionally. Working toward Target's goals and values creates a more productive and motivating work environment.

Roles and Duties:

  • Abide by safety protocols and guidelines to maintain a hazard-free workplace and prevent accidents.
  • Sign up for safety training programs that teach you on how to handle the fast-paced warehouse environment without compromising your safety.
  • A crucial aspect of the supply chain, this position involves packing, loading, and shipping goods to ensure timely delivery to stores and customers.
  • Maintain the accuracy of product processing to ensure successful delivery to our stores and customers.
  • Prioritize safety, speed, and efficiency in handling freight and transferring inventory from one place to the other in the warehouse.
  • A well-organized work area is essential to effective work performance and successful task completion.
  • Arrive punctually to begin work duties and carry out tasks assigned with precision and timeliness.
  • To excel at problem solving, it's important to create a culture that encourages employees to identify and report issues. Providing training and resources can also assist in developing effective problem solving skills
  • Upholds a constructive and cordial attitude while carrying out responsibilities independently or within a team atmosphere.

Requirements:

  • Able to bear the weight of merchandise weighing between 35-50 pounds multiple times throughout a workday.
  • Can move and transport items weighing up to 60 pounds occasionally during their work shift.
  • Execute movements including standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching repeatedly during work hours.
  • Demonstrate a positive and courteous demeanor when working independently or in a team atmosphere.
  • Skilled in proficiently applying elementary mathematical concepts like counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Possessing the ability to accurately interpret and comprehend the information on product labels, tickets, and other documentation.
  • After being trained, indiviudals can use computer systems and handheld devices with minimal direction and without much trouble.
  • Whether it is verbal or written communication, the effectiveness of your message can impact success in your professional and personal life
  • Sufficient proficiency in the English language is essential to properly grasp safety protocols, rules, and instructions provided through training and instructional materials.

Additional Requirements:

  • Capable of safely using and being instructed on all powered equipment such as Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down and Standup Forklift, among others, and able to conform to the safety guidelines.
  • Conduct work operations at a height of up to 40 ft on a mezzanine level, as appropriate
  • Adapt at working in different conditions that may include refrigerated or frozen environments, for a substantial amount of time during the work shift.

At Inter-Con we take pride in providing customized security solutions for our clients. To us, that means the right officer in the right place and at the right time. In many cases our clients desire a softer security plan that meets their values and needs, but where high value people and assets are involved, others may prefer a more obvious security presence. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you will be part of a highly trained security team that supports critical facilities and infrastructure, public venues that required an enhanced presence and personal protective services. You’ll be trained by our team of highly qualified firearms instructors in safe weapons handling and marksmanship. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you are an integral part of the broad spectrum of specialized security services Inter-Con provides its clients every day.

Competitive Pay

Training and Career Development.

Opportunities for Medical, dental, Holidays, vacation and sick, and 401 (k) retirement plan.

Uniform and equipment provided

Additional benefits vary depending on position.

Document all physical security breaches/incidents and actions taken in response.

Respond to all alarm conditions and any other indication of suspicious activities.

Meet and greet all tenants, sign-in visitors and contractors.

Respond effectively to all calls for assistance.

Treat Client’s employees, invitee’s, and guest with the utmost courtesy and respect.

Must undergo employment verification check back to age 18.

Must undergo motor vehicle record checks.

Must be 21 years or older.

May be required to perform emergency duties which require physical exertion such as: standing or walking for an entire shift, climbing stairs, lifting, carrying objects up to 75 lbs., and running.


Education and Experience:


High school diploma or equivalent; possession of a college degree is highly desirable.

Speak, read, and write English.

All assigned personnel should be of high integrity and possess exemplary security skills and judgment.

Assigned personnel should possess above average computer skills and must hold all necessary and required licenses, permits and certifications required by the States and/or Countries of assignment to perform security officer duties.


Inter-Con Overview

Founded in 1973, Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is a leading US-owned security company, providing integrated security solutions to government and commercial customers on four continents. Inter-Con remains under family ownership and control and operates as the industry leader in the field of customized, high-requirement security solutions. Inter-Con employs over 35,000 security personnel world-wide, trained and managed by a team of professionals with unsurpassed military, law enforcement, and security experience. Inter-Con is Everywhere Security Matters.


Why Work at Inter-Con?

Passion: Inter-Con is a thriving company that is passionate about its products and people. Joining the Inter-Con family is an opportunity for growth and career advancement in an environment that truly cares for its employees. By joining the Inter-Con family, you’re working with the best to build a safer future.

People: Inter-Con is more than a company, it’s an alumni base. We believe in positioning the right people in the right place to help them achieve their long-term aspirations for career growth. We have transitioned thousands of officers into successful careers in law enforcement, government agencies, foreign affairs and many more. Your career success drives our success.

Benefits: Inter-Con offers excellent benefits that include flexible scheduling to accommodate lifestyle commitments, vacation, sick leave, medical, dental, comprehensive training, discounts on higher education and much more.

Partner with us to begin a journey that begins with a commitment and leads to a career of a lifetime. Stand out. Be proud. Be Inter-Con!

jobs.description:
Location: Chicago & Surrounding Suburbs | Employment Type: Seasonal, May-August | Compensation: $25.00 an hour

About Inner Valor

At Inner Valor, we deliver hospitality-driven security for large-scale festivals and high-profile events. Our officers are not simply present—they are engaged, observant, and proactive, creating a safe environment while enhancing the guest experience.

Position Summary

We are seeking high-performing Event Security Officers who demonstrate strong judgment, professional presence, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-attendance environments.

This role is best suited for individuals who take pride in their work, communicate confidently, and can anticipate and address issues before they escalate.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute access control operations, including ID verification and credential enforcement, with consistency and professionalism
  • Conduct security screenings, including bag checks and handheld or walk through metal detector procedures, in accordance with site protocols
  • Maintain situational awareness across large crowds, identifying risks early
  • Support safe and efficient guest flow, including entry, exit, and restricted areas
  • Apply clear communication and de-escalation techniques when addressing issues
  • Respond decisively to incidents, disturbances, and emergency situations
  • Represent Inner Valor with a polished, customer-focused presence at all times
What Sets You Apart

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate:

  • Strong awareness, attention to detail, and decision-making ability
  • The ability to remain calm, composed, and professional under pressure
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • A team-first mindset with a high level of accountability
  • Reliability—you show up early, prepared, and ready to perform
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED
  • Ability to work long shifts (8-12+ hour shifts) in dynamic environments
  • Reliable transportation to various event locations across Chicago and the suburbs
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills
  • Comfortable working in outdoor event environments
  • Must pass background check and drug test
Preferred Qualifications:
  • PERC card & 20-hour Basic Security Training certification
  • Experience in event security, hospitality, military, or law enforcement
  • CPR/First Aid certification
  • Prior experience working large-scale events or high-attendance venues
Physical & Mental Requirement:

This role requires sustained physical presence, environmental adaptability, and continuous alertness in dynamic event settings. Responsibilities include:

  • Remaining on your feet for extended periods (8–12+ hours), including standing, walking, and active monitoring
  • Working outdoors for prolonged durations in varying weather conditions (heat, sun, wind, rain, and other environmental factors)
  • Operating effectively in crowded, high-noise environments, including entry points and screening areas
  • Maintaining constant situational awareness, attention to detail, and focus throughout the duration of the shift
  • Communicating clearly and effectively with guests and team members in fast-paced and sometimes stressful conditions
  • Navigating dense crowds, restricted areas, stairs, and uneven terrain as required by the event site

jobs.title: Safety and Security Officer - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Description

Our most important asset is our people. Who we are, what we do, how we do it and why we are passionate are all centerpieces of why we succeed.

We are proud to be recognized:

  • Among America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes in 2021, 2022 and 2024
  • As a Chicago Tribune Top Workplace for four consecutive years (2021-2025)

This role will operate onsite 5 days week, Monday – Friday. The 2nd shift hours are 2pm – 10pm.

Role Summary

As the Safety and Security Officer, you will be responsible for ensuring a safe and secure work environment for employees, contractors, and visitors at Fellowes U.S. facilities. The Safety and Security Officer will proactively focus on hazard identification, safety observations, and safety and security inspections. Additionally, the position will utilize safety and security systems and respond to, investigate, and document any incidents that occur on company property, while protecting employees, company property, and assets.

In This Role, You Will

  • Complete safety inspections, safe work observations, and safety audits to identify safe and unsafe workplace conditions and behaviors.
  • Incident response for injuries, accidents, property damage, security incidents, weather events, and facility evacuations.
  • Complete incident reports for safety and security events.
  • Navigate and monitor safety and security systems to include fire alarm & fire suppression, access control program, visitor management software, security alarm system, ESS database/safety software, and CCTV systems.
  • Conduct internal and external tours of the facility to ensure physical security.
  • Provide excellent customer service and facility access for employees, contractors, and visitors.
  • Process deliveries, interoffice mail, BOL’s, property passes, and safety and security supply inventories.
  • Serve as an on-site point of contact for fire department, police department, and safety/security vendors when necessary.
  • Collaborate with other members of the Environmental, Safety, and Security Department, along with other areas of the business to help drive continuous improvement and awareness in the areas of safety and security.
  • Maintain security records, equipment reports, inspections, key control records, and visitor logs.
  • Conduct drug & alcohol screens.
  • Provide additional support for special events and meetings.
  • Escalate safety and security incidents to the Senior Environmental, Safety, and Security Specialist, as needed.

What You Bring to the Team

  • At least 3 years experience in a security or safety role preferably in a corporate/warehouse/manufacturing environment.
  • Familiarity with safety and security systems and equipment.
  • Basic understanding of security and safety concepts, methodologies, and requirements.
  • High school diploma is required. A degree in Criminal/Social Justice or Occupational Health and Safety preferred.
  • Ability to safety operate a company van and powered industrial equipment.
  • Understand and follow Security Department Standard Operating Procedures and Emergency Response Plans.
  • Maintain certification in first aid, CPR, and AED’s.
  • Proficient in Windows based programs and applications.
  • Ability to adapt to a quickly changing and sometimes fast-paced environment.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information, while demonstrating integrity and professionalism.
  • Lead and influence without direct authority.
  • Flexibility to work overtime occasionally, as needed.

The hiring range for this position in Itasca, IL starts at $20-22hr. The shift differential is $.60/hr. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills and experience, among other factors. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits may be provided, dependent on the level and position offered. jobs.description: Job Description As an Armored Driver Guard, you work with your team to ensure the safe and secure pickup and delivery of cash, coin, and valuables. Responsibilities · Drive automatic armored vehicles and other vehicles on designated routes servicing customer locations · Service ATMs and Smart Safes · Service customer stops, including delivering customer change orders and picking up deposits. · Load/unload vehicle cargo including multiple bags and boxes of coins · Count items, record, and sign for cargo items · Other duties as assigned by management Requirements · At least 21 years of age · At least a 3 year driving record · Ability to obtain Medical Examiners Certificate via US Department of Transportation approved medical examiners · A valid firearms permit or ability to pass applicable firearms requirements may be required Loomis will pay for security and firearms qualifications, licensing and permitting. Working Conditions · Full-time schedule potentially consisting of an average 40 to 50 hours/week, with minimum of 5 days during a 6-day period. Occasional weekend work · Approximately 90-95 percent of work performed in air-conditioned vehicle within individual compartments (front and rear) Essential Duties/Job Qualifications As part of the qualification process for the Armed Driver Guard position, a Human Performance Evaluation (HPE) is required. This evaluation requires successful completion of testing in the following areas:Lift:- 25lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 66 inches from the floor (1X)Lift-Carry:- 18lbs vertical lift from 1 inch to 44 inches from the floor, and horizontally transfer 15ft (4X)- 18lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 300ft (1X)- 50lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 2ft (2X)Push-Pull:- Horizontally transfer 47lbs of force on a sled (single, non-dominant arm), a distance of 1ft (2X)Repetitive Coupling:- Squeeze Jamar Hand Dynamometer requiring forces up to 30lbs / both right & left hands (4X)Climb:- Ascend / Descend a step with heights of 16. 21 & 24 inches from the floor (10X) Benefits Loomis offers one of the most comprehensive employees benefit packages in the industry, which includes: · Vacation and Sick Time (PTO) as well as Paid Holidays · Health & Dental Insurance · Vision Insurance · 401(k) Plan · Basic Life Insurance Plan · Voluntary Life Insurance Plan · Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account · Dependent Care Account · Industry leading Training and Development

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position of Security Advisor located in Houston, TX through 08/10/2026 at 11:59 p.m. (Central Time).

Chevron Corporation is one of the world’s leading integrated energy companies with subsidiaries that conduct business across the globe. Chevron explores for, produces, and transports crude oil and natural gas; refines, markets, and distributes transportation fuels and other energy products and services; manufactures and sells petrochemical products; generates power and produces geothermal energy; and develops and commercializes the energy resources of the future, including biofuels and other renewables.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

  • Conduct complex investigations to protect Chevron’s people, assets, information, and interests. Investigations may include but are not limited to allegations of fraud, conflict of interest, misuse of company assets, policy violations, intellectual property loss and theft.
  • Prepare investigative reports and brief senior management and company legal representatives on investigative findings.
  • Develop and assesses threat information, in coordination with the geopolitical risk team, to determine impact on company staff and operations.

Conduct security risk and management assessments at designated company facilities and recommend risk-based security measures to protect company personnel and assets; support emergency planning and response; provide integrated security assistance to enable the safe and secure execution of major business decisions, projects, and base business.
  • Advise on and implement best-practice and cost-effective risk-based security policies and procedures.
  • Develop and maintain working relationships and liaison with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies and peer private sector security professionals.
  • Provide executive protection for senior company officers when required.
  • Participate in the planning and execution of security services for special events and other major company activities.
  • Perform other duties as determined by Global Security management.

  • This position requires occasional international travel.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in law enforcement and/or corporate security
  • Proven experience conducting complex investigations.

  • Demonstrated initiative and a self-starter, with proven ability to lead and motivate.

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

jobs.title: Regional Security Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Regional Security Specialist

Job Summary

The Regional Senior Security Manager (RAM) assumes a multifaceted role responsible for the seamless management of guard service operations and security-related functions based in Austin, TX. The RAM will support client operations in Austin, TX. This entails fostering client satisfaction, resolving conflicts, and overseeing various operational aspects, including scheduling, staffing, billing, training, and compliance.

Why Securitas?

Joining Securitas means being part of a global leader committed to excellence and innovation. We offer a unique environment that nurtures individual growth and rewards performance. You will be part of a team that values integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness, making a real difference in the communities we serve.

If you are ready to take on this challenging and rewarding role and be part of a performance-driven culture of purpose, execution, and belonging, we want to hear from you. Be part of our journey to make the world a safer place.

Benefits

Securitas will offer a starting salary of $85,000-$92,000, in addition to a full benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 10 accrued vacation days, 4 floating holidays, and 6 sick days
  • 401K

Key Responsibilities

  • Core Values and Client Relations:
  • Exemplify Securitas’ Core Values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring high-quality services and client satisfaction.
  • Service Quality and Compliance:
  • Continuously assess service quality and proactively address issues.
  • Develop and implement training programs and ensure compliance with regulations.
  • Establish and maintain performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Global Coordination and Networking:
  • Collaborate with the Global Program Manager (GPM) to align with global security objectives and initiatives.
  • Identify and utilize networking opportunities for standardizing processes and service delivery.
  • Staff Development and Management:
  • Oversee staff development, provide feedback and coaching.
  • Ensure proper scheduling, staffing, and cost efficiencies.
  • Administer resolutions to issues and discipline as needed.
  • Operational and Financial Oversight:
  • Manage invoice and payment processes, including expenditures.
  • Collaborate on policy and procedure management.
  • Monitor client credits and adjust as necessary.
  • Communication and Coordination:
  • Maintain ongoing communication with all stakeholders.
  • Prepare, develop, and deliver dynamic quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
  • Perform any additional duties as assigned by the Global Program Manager.

Education/Experience

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in security industry-related fields or business management.
  • Must have 3+ years’ experience of direct supervisory or management experience.
  • Previous law enforcement experience preferred.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.

Key Competencies

  • Strong security and business management experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of security operations and procedures.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Strong financial experience.
  • Ability to interpret, track, and maintain schedules, metrics, and performance indicators.
  • Budget planning and forecasting experience.
  • Capacity to maintain composure and professionalism in unusual circumstances.
  • Adaptability to rapidly changing environments or assignments.
  • Proficiency in computer skills, particularly Microsoft Office and data visualization tools.
  • Strong team collaboration and client-centric mindset.

If joining our management team sounds like the right fit for you, please click apply today!

Company Website: https://www.securitasinc.com

Securitas is committed to equal opportunity employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

About Us

Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are represented by the three red dots in the Securitas logo. If you live by these values, we’re looking for you to join the Securitas team.

Benefits Include

  • Retirement plan
  • Employer-provided medical and dental coverage
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Voluntary life and disability insurance
  • Employee assistance plan

Additionally, some populations may have the availability of accessing earned wages on a daily basis, prior to payday. Restrictions and fees may apply.

Certain waiting periods may also apply. Paid time away from work may be available either through a combination of vacation and sick time or under a PTO policy, depending on local requirements. Benefits may be different for union members.

About The Team

Our Company Mission:

Securitas’ mission is to protect homes, workplaces, and communities by providing the security services they need to protect their assets, safeguard their people, and maintain their ability to generate profits.

Our Values

Securitas’ core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are the foundation for our employees to build trust with customers, colleagues, and the surrounding community.

Integrity

Securitas employees are honest and trusted by customers to safeguard their premises and valuables. We don’t compromise on integrity and create an open forum for our employees and customers to voice opinions, report improprieties, and share information.

Vigilance

Seeing, hearing, and evaluating. A Securitas employee is always attentive and often notices things that others don’t. Their vigilance is necessary in order to be aware of potential risks or incidents that may take place on our customers’ premises.

Helpfulness

As part of an on-going effort to ensure safety, Securitas employees are always ready to help if an incident occurs that requires intervention regardless of whether or not it is directly related to their job.

jobs.title: Security Officer/Driver at La Rabida Children's Hospital Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
Security Officer/Driver job at La Rabida Children's Hospital. Chicago, IL.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital provides specialized, family-centered health care to children with medically complex conditions, disabilities, and chronic illness. Through expertise, compassion, and advocacy we help children and their families reach their fullest potential, regardless of their ability to pay.

Our not-for-profit hospital, licensed for 49 beds, helps transition children from neonatal or pediatric intensive care to home, by providing medical, rehabilitative and developmental care, and by training families to continue treatments and manage the necessary equipment in the home. La Rabida also provides extensive rehabilitation for those recovering from wounds or burns and treatment for exacerbations of chronic conditions.

The hospital’s enhanced pediatric patient-centered medical home provides primary care to children with complex medical conditions and their siblings. Children with medical homes elsewhere come to La Rabida for specialty services. La Rabida offers a wide range of specialty services provided to children with sickle cell disease, diabetes, and many others.

Children are supported in their emotional and developmental growth, particularly in cases where such growth has been interrupted by accident or disease.

Finally, La Rabida provides forensic and treatment services for children exposed to abuse and neglect, comprehensive assessments for youth in care, early intervention for children between 0 and 3 years of age. Care coordination services for medically complex children are also provided for those who are covered by a health plan and receive care from providers in Cook County

Job Description

The Security Officer/Driver patrols and maintains surveillance of the Hospital, both internally and externally, to ensure the physical safety of our employees and the patients we serve. The Security Officer/Driver additionally services patients, visitors, and staff through verbal interaction and vehicular transportation. The percentage of time spent in each capacity varies according to days and shifts worked, as well as shuttle and transportation needs.

Security Officer (35 - 85%)

  • Patrols internal and external building: hallways, secure and open doors, patrol parking areas
Driver (35 - 85%)
  • Operates shuttle service to and from the University of Chicago (Hourly shuttles between 7:30am - 5:30pm, weekdays only and excluding holidays). Also provides US Postal pick-up (weekdays only and excluding holidays)
  • Provides special transportation services: patient transports to off-site healthcare facilities, donation pick-up, vehicle maintenance, and various trips as requested
Information Desk Operations (10%)
  • Greets and directs visitors
  • Issue visitor's passes
  • Communication command station for Security and Transportation Drivers
  • Triage Emergency Room patients
  • Monitors life safety systems
  • Answers Incoming Calls
  • Internal Paging
  • Maintains presence as primary attendant console lunch/break
Camera and door surveillance equipment (5%)
  • View Camera monitor and change tape
  • Inspection Door printouts

Qualifications

  • High School diploma/GED Required
  • Customer Service background. Prefer at least two years experience as a Security Officer in healthcare environment
  • 20-hour basic Security Training Program Certification (Certification waived for current/previous Security/Law Enforcement Officers)
  • Valid State Driver's License - No major driving violations in past year
  • Must maintain valid driver's license while employed in this position
  • Knowledge of basic security operation

Additional Information

La Rabida Children’s Hospital is very proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer La Rabida is a place unlike any other.

We understand the needs of families with children dealing with the most serious or complicated of conditions. With teams of the best healthcare providers in Chicago, we give continuous, comprehensive care, education, and support, helping families face their unique obstacles head-on.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital is very proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Security Officer (Part Time)
jobs.description:
Security Officer (Part Time)

Would you like to be part of a team that keeps the cast, crew, celebrity guests and co-workers at The Walt Disney Company safe and secure? Our Security Officers do it all, from working special events like Disney shows to regular perimeter checks of our buildings and offices. If you thrive in an environment where no two days are exactly alike, and where professionalism and precision are valued, apply today to join us!

As a Security Officer, you’d be part of a well-trained, cohesive team that provides 24/7 protection for co-workers and guests at our buildings and at special events. Your mission? To protect Disney property and safeguard our people!

Every day as a Security Officer is different! Depending on your shift, on any given day you might:

  • Greet visitors, check company IDs, and provide temporary IDs at building entrances

  • Evaluate and screen the audience line at live TV shows

  • Be a security presence at movie premiers, live performances, events, or private parties

  • Patrol hallways and building perimeters to spot safety issues or irregularities

  • Fill out the logbook precisely and completely

  • Answer questions asked by visitors and employees in a friendly, professional way

  • Use your know-how and training to diffuse a tense situation

  • Respond to medical or fire incidents, and work directly with local first responders

  • Assist private security details brought by celebrities, sports stars, politicians and visiting dignitaries – even the President has been known to stop by

  • Control messenger flow and package delivery

  • Utilize technology to report and document incidents and manage information flow

  • Perform walk-through evaluation at off-site events

Here’s what you will need to be successful in the job:

  • 1 year of corporate security, law enforcement or military experience

  • Excellent communication skills, including fluent written and spoken English, and strong command of basic English grammar

  • Ability to make quick decisions using your training and common sense

  • The knack for talking to people in a friendly way that gets results

  • A “team” orientation and willingness to collaborate

  • Physical ability to perform all aspects of the job and be outside in all weather; and

  • Flexible workdays/hours (this is a “shift work” role) and ability to work some overtime

It would be a plus if you also have these skills:

  • Valid Security Guard license issued by your state

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

  • Experience working under pressure

  • Ability to take command and diplomatically control difficult situations

Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required

  • Associate degree or higher preferred

Some of the perks we offer include:

  • Taking part in ongoing learning on subjects such as CPR, Imminent Threat Assessment and First Aid training.

  • Attending a movie screening or television taping, enjoying the full array of benefits offered by The Walt Disney Company including paid time off, 401K participation, a retirement savings plan, discounts on a wide variety of offerings, medical/dental/vision insurance and educational reimbursement-just to name a few!

jobs.title: 10 HOSP Ann & Robert H. Lurie Childrens Hospital of Chicago is hiring: Security Officer Sergeant in Chicago
jobs.company: 10 HOSP Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago
jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES
* Conduct training for new cadets and provide ongoing in-service training for Security Services staff.
* Provide leadership to lower ranking Security Officers through counseling, mentorship, and ongoing training resources.
* Perform supervisory duties when a Supervisor is absent.
* Schedule and direct work assignments for lower ranking Security Officers.
* Enforce Medical Center policies, guidelines, and procedures, serving as the source of authority.
* Perform on‑foot patrols of Medical Center campuses as directed by the Director of Security or designate.
* Report safety and fire hazards observed on routine patrols and inspections; identify violations of the Joint Commission, OSHA, NFPA, and local Fire Code.
* Maintain constant communications with the Security Control Center.
* Assist clinical staff with psychiatric patient restraint, monitor and mitigate combative patients, escort patients during clinical transport, and observe patients under medical or psychiatric restrictions.
* Perform emergency responses, including distress calls, panic alarms, fire and disaster response, and support on-site emergencies such as bomb threats, patient abduction, weapon incidents, and hazardous materials.
* Physically intervene to remove unauthorized persons from hospital property, intervene with disruptive adults, confront individuals suspected of criminal acts, substance use, or disorderly conduct.
* Operate locks or unlock specified entrances/exits and perform access control duties at assigned posts.
* Ensure only authorized personnel are admitted; confront unauthorized persons for questions, routing, or detainment as appropriate.
* Dispatch Security Control room operations using Computer‑Aided‑Dispatch systems, monitor CCTV, radio transmissions, alarm consoles, and customer phone calls.
* Utilize incident report software to complete reports, maintain records, and assist the department with data collection.
* Apart from the above duties, appear in court on behalf of the Medical Center to enforce prosecution of individuals for assault or criminal trespass.
* Direct traffic on campus property and control parking, enforce parking guidelines for visitors, contractors, and employees.
* Serve as a resource of information for patients, parents, visitors, and employees, escorting them as needed.
* Secure lost and found items and maintain logs of received items.
* Enhance personal professional growth and maintain currency in the security field through voluntary participation in educational programs and departmental training sessions.
* Operate the hospital shuttle vehicle when required, ensuring safe compliance with all traffic laws.
* Consistently demonstrate customer service values and goals, adhering to service principles with a focus on innovation, excellence, and teamwork to serve patients, families, co‑workers, and others.
QUALIFICATIONS
* High school diploma or equivalent (required).
* Minimum of three years of security experience, preferably in a hospital setting.
* Valid Illinois Driver’s License.
* International Association for Hospital Security and Safety (IAHSS) supervisory training certification (required).
* Good verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with strong English reading, writing, and comprehension.
* Computer literate with working knowledge of Windows‑based software applications and typing ability.
* Excellent customer service skills.
Compensation: Pay Range $21.00 – $32.55 per hour.
The range reflects minimum and maximum targets for the position and is regularly reviewed to align with market conditions.
BENEFITS
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Employer‑paid group term life and disability insurance.
* Employer contribution toward Health Savings Account.
* Flexible Spending Accounts.
* Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* 403(b) retirement plan with a 5% employer match.
* Various voluntary benefits, including supplemental life, AD&D, and disability coverage, critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity coverage.
* Tuition assistance.
* Student loan servicing and support.
* Adoption benefits.
* Backup childcare and eldercare.
* Employee assistance program and other specialized behavioral health services for employees and family members.
* Discount on services at Lurie Children’s facilities.
* Discount purchasing program.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Lurie Children’s and its affiliates are equal employment opportunity employers.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, order of protection status, protected genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Dispatch Incident Intake in Richardson, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. As a Dispatch Officer at a commercial real estate location, you will coordinate communications, monitor security-related activity, document incidents, and support timely responses to calls for service. You will help maintain an organized environment while delivering exceptional customer service to tenants, visitors, and team members. Join Allied Universal, where agility, reliability, innovation, teamwork, caring, and integrity guide every shift.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $20.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeMon10:00 PM - 06:00 AMTue10:00 PM - 06:00 AMWed10:00 PM - 06:00 AMThur10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, employees, and/or vendors by carrying out site-specific procedures, access-control protocols, and emergency response activities at a commercial real estate location.
  • Monitor and dispatch security-related personnel to alarms, service requests, incidents, and critical situations, maintaining clear communication through radios, phones, and/or dispatch systems.
  • Receive, document, prioritize, and relay calls for assistance, maintenance-related concerns, and security-related incidents in a calm, problem-solving manner.
  • Maintain accurate dispatch logs, incident reports, visitor information, key and/or access-control records, and other site documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and location procedures.
  • Monitor cameras, alarms, and building systems as assigned, report unusual activity, and coordinate appropriate response personnel.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Have at least one year of security-related experience.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • CPR/First Aid certification is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.
Closing

Allied Universal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


We’re looking for a Security Lead to join our Corporate Security team to help protect Collector’s personnel, property, and profits through detection, deterrence, and denial of unauthorized individuals, all while maintaining a secure environment and preserving the integrity of the company’s facilities and reputation within a 24/7 security environment. Our Security vigilance protects Collectors from exposure, damage to reputation and theft

.

You’ll report to the Sr. Security Supervisor and work from our Plano, TX office.

Onsite Requirement:

This role requires you to be onsite in the office 5 days per week.


What You’ll Do:

  • Secure premises and personnel by patrolling property; monitoring surveillance equipment; inspecting buildings, equipment, and access points; permitting entry

  • Serve as the lead security contact, providing operational support and coordination for the team

  • Oversee daily operations, including shift coverage, incident response coordination, and communication with management

  • Support training efforts, ensuring team members understand and follow SOPs, site-specific protocols, and compliance standards

  • Prevent losses and damage by reporting irregularities.

  • Complete reports by recording observations, information, occurrences, and surveillance activities.

  • Maintain organization's stability and reputation by complying with legal requirements

  • Contribute to security team’s effort by accomplishing related duties as assigned

  • Make timely decisions, while maintaining composure in emergency response situations

  • Provide exceptional customer service

  • Respond to emergency situations to provide necessary assistance to employees and customers


Who You Are:

  • Valid Non-Commissioned Security Officer License (Level II) is required

  • Valid Driver's License is required

  • At least 3 years of security experience required, preferably in a corporate environment.

  • You have prior experience serving as a Security Lead or Supervisor, with a proven ability to guide teams, delegate responsibilities, and uphold security protocols under pressure.

  • You are able to clearly communicate with a variety of individuals, both written and verbal.

  • You are able to analyze and use logic and reasoning to understand how a problem should be approached.

  • You have great active listening skills, foster trusting interpersonal relationships and you work well with others.

Physical Requirements:

  • Bending and Twisting: Bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, and squatting.

  • Computer Use: Typing, mouse work, and sitting and looking at a computer potentially for long periods of time.

  • Hand Use: Power gripping when using low-precision, high-impact hand tools that require significant force, such as hammer drills and torque wrenches.

  • Hearing Requirements: Ability to hear alarms, signals, and verbal instructions.

  • Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift, carry, and move materials up to 75+ pounds, with employee help or with proper equipment.

  • Sitting or Standing: Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time.

  • Temperature and Humidity: Occasional exposure to warehouse environments without heating or cooling with fluctuations in temperatures and humidity.

  • Walking: Ability to walk for long periods.

Hourly Range:

The hourly range for this position is $27-$30. Actual compensation in this range will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, prior experience, and skill set.

jobs.description:
Security Officer- Overnight (Texas Level 2 Certified)

Job Type: Seasonal
Pay Rate: $14.75/hr.
Category: Public Safety
Location: Six Flags Fiesta Texas in San Antonio, Texas

WHAT WE PROVIDE:

This is a seasonal overnight Security Officer position at Six Flags Fiesta Texas, in San Antonio, TX. It features a competitive hourly rate of $14.75 (with an additional $1 per hour for working the hours between 12am-8am) with perks such as: Free entry to any Six Flags Park for all employees and a guest with each visit, additional complimentary tickets for friends and family, discount on food and merchandise for all employees, flexible scheduling, Dayforce Wallet access for earned wage access, and bi-weekly pay.


Join the exhilarating world of Six Flags Fiesta Texas as an Overnight Security Officer, where you'll be the fearless protector of our vibrant park! With your State of Texas Level 2 license, you'll embark on thrilling patrols, ensuring the safety and security of our premises. From swiftly responding to security incidents to expertly screening guests at the front gate, you'll be at the heart of our security operations, upholding our commitment to excellence. With every assignment tackled with precision and passion, you'll play a pivotal role in creating unforgettable experiences for our guests and maintaining the highest standards of safety throughout the park.

HOW YOU WILL DO IT:

  • Gate Security: Employ meticulous verification processes to ensure only authorized personnel and vehicles access the park, verifying identification and passes with precision.
  • Confidentiality: Demonstrate unwavering commitment to confidentiality by carefully safeguarding sensitive information encountered during patrols or incidents, upholding the trust placed in you.
  • Rapid Response: Be ready to spring into action at a moment's notice, responding promptly and decisively to security-related incidents within the park to mitigate risks and ensure the safety of guests and staff.
  • Documentation: Utilize your exceptional communication skills to write clear, concise, and comprehensive reports detailing incidents and the actions taken, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Law Enforcement Compliance: Execute your duties with a firm commitment to upholding local, state, and federal laws on park property, ensuring a safe and compliant environment for all.
  • Asset Protection: Exercise vigilance and proactive measures to safeguard company assets, property, and facilities against potential threats and illegal activities, acting as a steadfast guardian of the park's resources.
  • Traffic Control (as required): Assume control of traffic operations with precision and efficiency, managing vehicular flow and ensuring the safety of guests during peak times and special events.
  • Patrol Proficiency: Conduct thorough and systematic vehicle and bike patrols throughout the park, covering all areas to detect and deter potential security threats effectively.
  • Collaborative Approach: Foster strong partnerships with on-duty law enforcement personnel, facilitating seamless cooperation and coordination in maintaining park security and responding to incidents.
  • Dispatch Operations (as needed): Demonstrate proficiency in managing communications and resources as a dispatch operator when required, orchestrating responses and resolutions during emergencies with skill and composure.
  • Task Completion: Embrace a proactive attitude towards task completion, readily taking on any additional assignments delegated by management with dedication and efficiency.
  • Policy Adherence: Adhere strictly to Six Flags Fiesta Texas handbook policies at all times, setting the standard for professionalism and conduct while ensuring compliance with park regulations and protocols.

  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods of time in South Texas Weather.
  • Must be willing and able to perform foot and bike patrols.

  • Safety conscious, mature, reliable and dependable.
  • Outgoing and friendly demeanor.

  • Must be able to work flexible shifts including but not limited to overtime, weekends and some holidays.

jobs.description:
Schedule:

Sunday-Thursday 10pm-6:30am

Pay: $20.50/hr

Use a variety of material handling equipment to move products, equipment, and materials on and off trucks or throughout the facility while following all regulatory and company safety standards, policies, and procedures.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Put away palletized units by lifting forks for placement into racks above floor height
  • Pick palletized units out of rack locations above floor height and set up for outbound shipment
  • May choose and record materials, weight, counts, and condition of food items via Radio Frequency (RF) system
  • Load and unload materials on and off pallets, skids, or lifting device
  • Read and follow computerized work orders to determine quantities, types of products to be shipped and the location of requested items in the warehouse
  • Document and report damages and discrepancies to supervisors or leads
  • May need to pack, seal, and label materials/pallets for shipping using Radio Frequency (RF) scanning equipment to document and verify counts of picked items; otherwise, ensure all palletized stock is securely wrapped before placement on racks or transporting through the warehouse
  • Complete daily forklift maintenance/check sheet
  • Monitor battery charge and leave material handling equipment at the designated storage area; may need to maintain and clean batteries, depending on site
  • Alert appropriate leader of any issues with the product or materials and await directions to rectify the problem
  • Help clean and organize the warehouse at the end or throughout the shift

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES)

  • Must be able to identify products through reading, interpreting, and scanning or manually inputting pallet identification numbers
  • Basic math skills
  • Ability to understand instructions in Country's official language or as defined by Lineage Logistics
  • Ability to work in temperatures as low as -20 Fahrenheit/-25 Celsius in cold storage sites or up to 100 Fahrenheit/37 Celsius in dry storage sites while wearing company provided personal protective equipment and freezer gear
  • Must be able to lift a minimum of 40 lbs./18 kgs.; weight may be more dependent upon facility
  • Ability to work a flexible work schedule and shift, including weekends if needed
  • Must be comfortable with various noise levels, at times, can be loud

jobs.title: Level II Flex Officer Alvarado, TX
jobs.description:
Level II Flex Officer Alvarado, TX


Flex Level II Officer


Shift: All Shifts


Pay Rate: $17.00 HR


Security’s Primary Purpose and Function

The Security Officer is responsible for providing security services at assigned locations with a focus on observing and reporting. Duties include, but are not limited to:

  • monitoring and reporting all activity,conducting foot patrols, vehicular patrols, golf cart patrols, and/or bicycle patrol of applicable interior and/or exterior areas;
  • reporting suspicious activities, suspicious persons,
  • writing detailed narrative reports,
  • maintaining daily activity reports (DAR’s),
  • enforcing post orders, site rules, regulations, policies, procedures,
  • and responding to emergency situations requiring security assistance.


Position Overview & Scope

  • Conduct regular and random patrols of the interior and perimeter of the facility and identify potential safety risks, security risks and undesirable conditions.
  • Provide customer service to our clients by carrying out safety and security procedures, site-specific policies and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Must have good interpersonal, organizational, verbal and written communication skills and be able to perform multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Must be able to walk long distances, sit or stand for long periods of time. Must be able to kneel and bend to look into tight spaces – all with, or without, accommodation.


Security’s Essential Functions and Responsibilities

The following are the duties that are necessary to satisfy the minimum requirements of the position. Other duties may be assigned on an as-needed basis.

  • Responsible for executing security services as outlined in the Post Order Manual and accompanying policy and procedural guidelines and as directed by SMSSI Management.
  • May be responsible for conducting walking patrols of building/facility (or assigned areas within or outside the building/facility) and include vehicular patrols, golf cart patrols and/or bicycle patrols.
  • Responsible for identifying and reporting security threats, unsafe conditions or hazards, and/or other emergency situations.
  • Responsible for site-specific duties and tasks based on assignment, which may include customer service, loss prevention, retail security, lobby/visitor reception, service/freight elevator security, loading dock security, and/or a variety of other safety and security roles.
  • Write detailed, accurate, and legible incident reports during shift, including notation of any unusual activities and how issues were resolved. Responsible for contacting appropriate individuals (Site Supervision, Field Management, etc.) as directed by site post orders or as needed during shift.
  • Responsible for knowing all site-specific policies and procedures, and implementing emergency response activities as appropriate.
  • Responsible for following all company procedures, maintaining acceptable attendance, and adhering to all grooming and customer service standards.
  • Responsible for participating in all company and site required orientation and training programs.
  • Respond to any incidents that occur during shift, in conformity with the Post Orders and the Company’s Use of Force Policy, ensuring appropriate action is taken, all reports are properly completed, and appropriate parties are notified in a timely manner.
  • Conduct security, customer service, or support function(s) as directed by supervisor or in support of client request(s).


Minimum Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, candidates must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or experience required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Minimum high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Current or prior military experience, or college education in the security field desirable.
  • Minimum 1-3 years of professional-level work experience preferred.
  • Must possess a valid registration/permit/license required by the state in which the employee is employed. As a condition of employment, employee must successfully complete a background investigation and a post-offer/pre-employment drug/alcohol test where required by the Company or client. Some clients require additional background screening, testing, and procedures.


Why St. Moritz?

Are you looking for a rewarding career in the security industry? Join St. Moritz Security Services, Inc., a well -established company with over 43 years in the industry.

No security program can be successfully implemented without quality people to execute the program.


The ST. MORITZ DIFFERENCE is our PEOPLE.

From the first level security officer to the CEO, St. Moritz is committed from the top down to provide the highest level of service possible.

jobs.title: Vice President, Solution Sales - Distribution & Fulfillment (P/LS)
jobs.description:
ITS Logistics is a leading Third-Party Logistics provider and an Echo Global Logistics company. We run a fully integrated platform - asset-based truckload, Dedicated & Fulfillment, LTL, Dray, Intermodal, and Managed Transportation - plus Roadtex, our temperature-controlled warehouse and distribution network. That combination gives our customers something most 3PLs can't offer: a single partner who can handle ambient fulfillment, confectionery-grade temp-controlled distribution, and everything in between.

We're a performance-driven organization. We invest in our people, give them real commercial infrastructure to work with, and get out of their way. If you're looking for a place where your output actually matters, this is it.

Want to learn more about ITS Logistics? Check out our website! www.its4logistics.com

About the Position

We're looking for a proven hunter who has spent their career selling warehouse and fulfillment solutions into the pharmaceutical and life sciences space - and who understands that in this vertical, compliance capability is the sale, not a checkbox.

This role sells the full ITS + Roadtex D&F platform: ITS omnichannel ambient warehouse and fulfillment for CPG manufacturers, food shippers, and e-commerce customers, and Roadtex temperature-controlled (confectionery-grade, 55–65°F) warehouse, distribution, and value-added services for customers who need food-safe, OTIF-compliant, retail-ready distribution.

There is no existing book to manage. You will prospect, qualify, design solutions, and close - from first call through contract. The platform is differentiated. The opportunity is real. We need someone who can execute.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect and close new business within the pharma and life sciences vertical - targeting pharmaceutical manufacturers, specialty distributors, clinical logistics providers, medical device companies, and nutraceutical brands.
  • Sell the full ITS + Roadtex D&F platform: ambient omnichannel fulfillment (ITS) and confectionery-grade temperature-controlled warehouse, distribution, and VAS (Roadtex).
  • Build and manage your own pipeline from scratch. Qualify opportunities, design integrated solutions, coordinate pricing, and lead pursuit cycles through close.
  • Engage VP and C-suite supply chain, logistics, and procurement contacts. This is not a coordinator-level sales motion.
  • Build multi-service proposals and ROI models - combining ambient warehouse, temp-controlled storage, VAS, and transportation into a single integrated solution.
  • Work with ITS and Roadtex operations and pricing teams to validate solutions operationally before proposals go out.
  • Use the Echo enterprise account base to identify cross-sell opportunities for ITS D&F and Roadtex capabilities.
  • Keep CRM clean - accurate deal values, stages, timelines, and probabilities on every active opportunity.
  • Transition closed accounts cleanly to the Enterprise Account Management team and stay involved where needed to protect revenue actualization.
  • Show up at trade events, customer meetings, and industry forums specific to food and nutrition supply chain.
  • Give leadership straight pipeline reporting - what's real, what's at risk, what's closing.

A bout the Requirements

  • 7+ years as an individual contributor selling 3PL warehouse and fulfillment solutions. Not sales management - field sales, closing deals.
  • You've consistently closed $12M+ per year in new logo warehouse and fulfillment revenue within the food, beverage, or nutrition space. We'll ask for specifics.
  • You built that pipeline yourself. Not from marketing programs, not from account lists handed to you. You know how to generate your own opportunities.
  • You are actively hunting in your current role - not managing accounts, not renewing contracts. You find new business and close it.
  • The product you've been selling is warehouse and fulfillment - physical 3PL services. Not transportation brokerage, not TMS, not managed services.
  • You understand how shippers evaluate 3PL outsourcing decisions - the RFP process, the stakeholders involved, how multi-year contracts get structured and won.
  • You've sold into food, beverage, nutrition, or CPG verticals and understand the compliance environment: OTIF, MABD, retail routing guide requirements.
  • You can engage confidently at VP and C-suite level and lead a complex, multi-stakeholder sales process without hand-holding.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.

Work environment/physical demands summary:

This job operates in an office environment and uses a computer, telephone and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office with an open seating floor plan. The employee may encounter frequent interruptions throughout the work day.
